summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of PAUSE (Expo web). All 8 requested flows verified successfully: onboarding (Continue as guest), 12 categories rendered with cover illustrations, Start discovering navigates to home, story cards tappable, reader opens with chapter-by-chapter navigation (scroll/wheel advances 01→06), bookmark persists to Saved tab, Profile shows reading stats (1 story read, 1 day streak, 4 min). The i18n string change is correct: 'Read & Learn' / 'Leggi e Impara' present in /app/frontend/src/i18n.tsx and used in home-story-card.tsx; no leftover 'mini lesson' or 'mini-lezione' wording found on any visited screen. Learn tab shows a premium lock (expected, premium disabled). App auto-detected EN but mixed IT/EN content shown as per seed data (expected). No fatal console or page errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key data-testids discovered: continue as guest via text match; home-story-* cards; reader-back, bookmark-button, like-button, share-story, next-story, ending-home-btn, ending-read-btn; bottom tabs via text 'Home/Topics/Saved/Profile'. Reader uses scroll/wheel to advance chapters. Initial Metro bundle load ~10-15s on preview; use 90s navigation timeout. Learn tab is premium-locked (expected). Content is Italian+English mix depending on seed. Mobile viewport 430x900.
